name: Visa-Free Entry / Type C Visa (Tourism, Short Stay)

requirements.blocker_text: Visa-free entry is granted to holders of a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa previously used in a Schengen state, holders of valid EU/US/UK residence permits or visas, and holders of EU travel documents (refugee travel documents, stateless-person documents). A time-limited tourism-only exemption also applies to Saudi and Qatari nationals (15 April - 31 December 2026).

requirement_groups.name: Type C Visa (short stay, non-exempt nationalities)

requirements.blocker_text: Type C visa permits stays of up to 90 days within any 180-day period, single/double/multiple entry, with visa validity of up to 5 years.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Type C visa via e-visa.al or a Dominican -- Albanian consulate.

evidence_required.document: Proof of accommodation and purpose of visit

outcome.duration_length: Up to 90 days within any 180-day period (Type C visa valid up to 5 years for repeat entries)

sources.title: Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs of Albania -- Visa regime for foreign citizens entering Albania: Type C (90/180 days, up to 5-year validity) and Type D visas, visa-free entry categories

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). The source page's visa-free list is not exhaustive on its face -- Albania has separate long-standing unilateral visa waivers for many non-EU nationalities (a well-known tourism policy) not itemized on this specific MFA page, which focuses on the EU/US/UK-residence-based and Schengen-transit-based exemptions plus the time-limited Saudi/Qatari waiver. Modeled the listed exemption bases as hard:false since the true scope of visa-exempt nationalities is broader and not fully captured at tier-1 precision in this pass. Switchable_to reflects that Type D visa holders (see al_work_permit, al_student_permit) can obtain a residence permit after entering Albania, per the same source.
